topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: Well, I've heard from old Eli that he's thinking of putting up a fence between our plots. It's a big step, a fence. I've been pondering on it, walking the lines of my own land, feeling the weight of the tools I've come to know so well. Fences change things, they do. They keep your livestock in and your crops safe, but they also draw lines where once there was just open space. I reckon I should speak to Eli soon, find out his plans. The soil and the weather can't be stopped, but the shape of our land—that's something we can shape. I hope the saints watch over us as we decide such matters. It's not an easy decision to make, with so much at stake.
